merge.analysis: The trusted acquire_source helper failed fetching frozen base 097170f6cae9228b701d0ed2ca102a8363680f8b from open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation because the sandbox could not connect to github.com:443. The frozen protocol and public visibility flags were checked, and the complete authoritative PR diff was read. Full head/base trees and conflict history remain unavailable, so the frozen refs, repository instructions, automatic merge, and preservation of both sides' intent could not be verified. No local merge or source changes were made.
merge.downsides: Conflict resolution and relevant repository checks remain incomplete until the permitted source acquisition is available.
merge.summary: Blocked: exact frozen public source could not be acquired
merge.upsides: Preserves both frozen branches unchanged and avoids inventing a resolution from an incomplete diff or substituting another source.

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.
